podcasts.description: Is crypto building a freer financial system, or giving Wall Street and Washington new ways to control it? Former CFTC Chairman Chris Giancarlo returns to Bankless to unpack crypto's political battles, why he believes Wall Street will move onto digital rails by 2040, and what the 2008 financial crisis taught him about the limitations of traditional finance. Plus, the evolution of Bitcoin futures and perpetuals, the debate over stablecoins and CBDCs, and why financial privacy may matter more than the technology itself.
